تمتدحوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَدِحُوا (tamtadiḥū) /tam.ta.di.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
# تُمْتَدَحُوا (tumtadaḥū) /tum.ta.da.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَدَحَ (imtadaḥa)
